description: Single source of truth for the phase-gated build: modules, what each needs from the others, the order they are built in, and the tests that prove each dependency before anything depends on it.

pest_groups.arch: Architecture rules (module boundaries, sole ledger writer, no statics, soft deletes)
pest_groups.invariants: Schema and route invariants (append-only, NUMERIC, branch_id, bilingual, idempotency, permission coverage)
pest_groups.unit: Pure unit tests incl. exhaustive state-machine tables
pest_groups.feature: HTTP feature tests, one per endpoint minimum
pest_groups.property: Randomised property tests on the ledger
pest_groups.concurrency: Second-connection row-lock tests; use DatabaseTruncation not RefreshDatabase
pest_groups.module:<name>: All tests owned by a module
pest_groups.contract:<consumer>-><provider>: Consumer-side tests against a provider; written before the consumer, green with zero consumer code
pest_groups.seeds: The demo bakery (DemoSeeder / PhaseNSeeder): idempotent, branch-isolated, ledger-consistent; runs in mod-inventory
